newsitem.title: CANADA: Westcoast B.C. gas plant back at full tilt.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast B.C. gas plant back at full tilt.

text.p: Westcoast Energy Inc said its Pine River natural gas plant in northeast British Columbia was repaired and returned to full service earlier this week.
Westcoast had declared a force majeure at the 398 million cubic feet per day plant on Christmas Eve after mechanical problems forced its output down by 33 percent.
"It's back and fully operational again," Westcoast manager of gas control and measurement Don Berkeley said on Thursday.
Berkeley said Pine River came fully on stream on Monday and Westcoast's entire two billion cubic feet per day British Columbia system was operating normally.

With temperatures on the west coast climbing back above normal after last week's freak snowstorms, gas prices at Sumas, Washington were being quoted at US$2 per million British thermal units and lower in thin trade, marketers said. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
